products.notes: Principal repayment: equal instalments monthly, every 3 months or every 6 months (customer chooses); interest paid monthly on actual outstanding balance (suggests reducing balance but the product page does not say so, so basis stays unknown). Loan method: per disbursement ('theo món'). Rate on the product page: 'Lãi suất cho vay: Theo quy định của MB từng thời kỳ' (re-read 2026-11-03). Calculators: the product page and https://www.mbbank.com.vn/ho-tro/cong-cu-va-tien-ich/tinh-toan-khoan-vay require the user to type the rate; their default output (30.812.500 total, 812.500 interest, instalments 2.625.000 falling to 2.510.417) equals 30 triệu, 12 months, 5%/năm, equal principal. That is a calculator default, not a published offer, and is not used.mbbank.credit/ has a calculator whose code (page-specific JavaScript) uses 14%/năm with a daily annuity over 30-day months (50 triệu, 15 months gives 120.997 VND per day). 14% is an illustrative constant on a lead-form page; it is neither a stated offer nor consistent with the page's own 'từ 0.7%/tháng', so it is not used. Its fees FAQ says only 'Trong hầu hết các sản phẩm, bạn sẽ không cần trả bất kỳ loại phí nào' (vague, not used as a fee statement). Insurance: nothing on the product page, fee schedules or rate disclosure; MB's article https://www.mbbank.com.vn/tin-tuc/tin-san-pham-dich-vu/bao-hiem-khoan-vay (21/11/2025) says loan insurance is voluntary under Circular 39 in general, not product-specific, so the empty list still does not prove none is sold. 'Vay nhanh - Vay theo lương' in the app appears to be a path within this same product family; no separate terms are published. Older MB pages (2015 and 2016 news about 'cho vay cá nhân tín chấp', up to 200-500 triệu, age 55/60-65) describe superseded policies and are not used. A third-party site (mytour.vn) claims MB lends this product with Mcredit; MB's own product page says nothing of the kind, so it is not used.

products.notes: Found 2026-11-03. Path in the app: Vay nhanh > Mua sắm, tiêu dùng > 'Vay siêu nhanh thấu chi từ thẻ tín dụng'. It still exists in the app: the FAQ of the current unsecured-loan product page (dateModified 2026-10-29) has a how-to for settling 'khoản vay thấu chi siêu nhanh từ thẻ tín dụng' (Khoản vay của tôi > Đóng khoản vay). That FAQ gives no rate or fee. The vnba.org.vn article says MB does not charge an early-repayment fee on this loan, rates and fees are shown in the app before applying, and the rate is 'từ khoảng 12%/năm'; all secondary, so none is stored as a fee or offered range. MB's general card article (20/03/2026) quotes cash-withdrawal fee about 4%, early settlement 1%-4% and a 12%-17%/năm card-loan rate range 'tùy theo ngân hàng', so it is market-wide, not MB-specific, and is not used. MB's own credit-card interest table (https://www.mbbank.com.vn/ho-tro/bieu-lai-suat?tab=lai-suat-cap-tin-dung, read 2026-11-03) lists 22,9%/năm (Infinite, World Elite, Priority, JCB Ultimate) to 30%-34,5%/năm (other cards, from 07/10/2026) on card balances; it is not stated whether the quick loan uses these rates. A promotion of 'giảm đến 3% lãi suất' ran 24-30/06/2025 and is expired. Credit-card products are outside the MVP list, but this is a cash-style loan offered to cardholders. To unlock: MB's in-app rate and fee screen or a loan contract for this facility.

researchNotes: Licensing: 'mb-bank' exists in data/licensed-institutions.json (Ngân hàng TMCP Quân Đội, category bank). RATE: no product rate is published. The product page says 'Lãi suất cho vay: Theo quy định của MB từng thời kỳ'. Searched on 2026-11-03: the product page and all its tabs, MB's rate disclosure page and its JSON feed (https://www.mbbank.com.vn/mb-website/v1/interest-rate/document-categories?languageCode=vi and .../documents?categoryId=...), all five KHCN reference-rate documents, the credit-card rate table, the fee-and-forms library (https://www.mbbank.com.vn/mb-website/v1/fee-form/individual/document-categories: 23 fee schedules, 2 forms, 9 terms and conditions, 519 decisions, 5 other), the mbbank.com.vn sitemaps (page, post, product), the MB articles on unsecured loans, overdraft, card loans, loan insurance and early settlement, MB's quick-loan landing page, and the App Store listing (loan mentioned without rate; Google Play could not be read). THE '12,5-20%/năm' LEAD: it is supported by one official source, but only weakly. MB's own article 'Vay tín chấp là gì?' (posted 26/03/2026, https://www.mbbank.com.vn/tin-tuc/blog/vay-tin-chap-la-gi) says 'khoảng 12,5% - 20%/năm', 'xét theo hồ sơ thực tế', 'chỉ mang tính chất tham khảo', updated 'tháng 4/2026'. It covers MB's unsecured loans in general, names no product and gives no calculation basis; it also states a limit of 800 triệu that contradicts the product page. The end points match a September 2023 trade-press article (tapchicongthuong.vn: 17,62%/năm standard unsecured, 12,5%/năm for public-sector staff, 20%/năm 'rút vốn nhanh'), which suggests the figures may be recycled. Recorded as a low-confidence benchmark, not an offered range. No MB product page, fee schedule or contract supports it for this product. OTHER RATE-LIKE FIGURES, all benchmark or floor: MB's quick-loan landing page FAQ 'từ 8% đến 22%/năm ... dư nợ giảm dần' (undated, generic) and tile 'Chỉ từ 0.7%/tháng'; its calculator code uses 14%/năm. These three disagree with each other. FEES: found the only loan-relevant fee in MB's general fee schedule for ordinary individual customers (applied 26/10/2026): early repayment 2%/1%/0,5% of the prepaid amount by year, minimum 100.000 VND, 'vay ngắn hạn: miễn phí'; its applicability to this product is not stated on the product page, so confidence is medium. The credit section (part E) of that schedule has no origination, appraisal or loan-management fee, but a schedule for this product was not found, so feesCompleteness is partial, not complete. The older schedule on the rate page (published 26/06/2026 on the site) has the same loan fee. The app fee schedule (Phụ lục 01, KHCN trên App MBBank) has no loan fee. LATE PENALTY and INSURANCE: not published for this product anywhere found. LOAN CONTRACT / T&C: none public (the terms library has account, e-banking, card and deposit terms only). OVERDRAFT (thấu chi): no public page for a mass-market unsecured overdraft. The old overdraft URL redirects to 'MB Pri Plus' (Priority/Private, mortgaged property); 'MB PriFlexi' is Priority/Private with collateral, 'cho vay thấu chi tiết kiệm số' is secured by savings, M.Companion is for military, and the Viettel staff scheme is staff-only; all outside the MVP target and not listed. The fee schedule has an overdraft-account set-up fee of 0,1% of the limit (min 100.000 VND), which is not tied to a product. A 2019 press article on a 5-50 triệu app overdraft is too old to use. ADD-ON: the fee schedule mentions customers on an 'add-on' (flat) rate with a 3% early-repayment fee, so some MB loans are quoted flat; it is not known whether this product is one. Contradictions: see conflicts on amountMaxVnd, amountMinVnd, termMaxMonths, termMinMonths (landing page and article vs product page) and eligibility age/income. Surprising: MB's own pages quote four different, unconnected rate ranges; the pricing is reachable only inside the app after a credit check. A 12-month minimum term and 10 triệu minimum make it a poor fit for small short loans. Mcredit is a separate lender in our data and is not covered here. EXCLUDED SOURCE: vaynhanh.mbbank.credit is not treated as an MB source. No mbbank.com.vn page we read links to it (checked 2026-11-03), and the domain was registered in March 2025 through a public registrar. Its figures (from 0.7% a month, 8-22% a year) are not stored unless MB confirms the site.
